**Calculation:**

2k sin 30° cos 30° cot 60° = frac{{{{cot }²}30^circ sec 60^circ tan 45^circ }}{{{{cose}}{{{c}}{²}}{{45^circ cosec 30}}^circ }}

⇒ 2k × (1/2) × (√3/2) × (1/√3) = ((sqrt3)²×2×1)/((sqrt2)²×2)

⇒ k/2 = 6/4
